title: Jiaozi: Song state issues standard paper notes
summary: Merchant notes in Chengdu were taken over by the state, which issued its first series of standard notes in 1024.
why: Regarded by numismatists as the first paper money in history.

notes.problem: Source attributes the claim to numismatists (tagged [who?]); state it as an attribution.

Source only says numismatists{who?} 'regard it as the first paper money' (short description: 'One of the first forms of paper money'); it does not call the 1024 issue the first government paper money.
